Synopsis:
Brem is a trader for the Zhentarim. When we meet him, he's holding an artist prisoner and offering us a portrait. We can persuade him to release the prisoner or just buy him outright - or just trade normally. He'll indicate that there are more illicit items he can show us - once we prove ourselves to his leader.

Cluster Contexts:
- PLA_ZhentDungeon_Zhent03.json: Brem is a Zhentarim trader/handler who’s presenting a captive artist as merchandise — he frames the artist as a “pet” in need of his protection while really holding him against his will. The Zhentarim in this area run illicit trade (weapons, exotic goods, prisoners) and are blunt, profit‑minded and suspicious; other Zhent figures (quartermasters like Roah Moonglow or gatekeepers such as Zarys) and their winged‑serpent sigil may be nearby. In the scene Brem offers to paint the player for coin, invites offers to buy or ransom the prisoner, and can be persuaded to free him instead of selling. He also hints there are more illicit items he’ll show you once you’ve proved yourselves to his superiors, so the exchange is treated as business rather than a moral plea.
- PLA_ZhentDungeon_DoubtingArtist.json: Oskar Fevras is an artist being held by Zhentarim operatives (a trader like Roah Moonglow or a handler named Brem are plausible) and is being forced to paint; he’ll approach the player quietly and plead to be bought or freed because his captors are within earshot. Interactions with his captors will likely be a negotiation or purchase — Zhentarim figures are blunt, profit‑minded, and suspicious (and the party may already be facing a tense Zhentarim gatekeeper like Zarys or dealing with an outpost being abandoned or even set alight). While still imprisoned Oskar is anxious and guarded in conversation; if liberated he quickly slips back into his old haughtiness but becomes grateful and will tell the party he’s torn between two loves: a wealthy patron offering marriage and a true love from his pre‑fame past.
- GOB_QuartermasterFlimsy.json: Roah Moonglow is a Zhentarim trader — you can spot the winged‑serpent crest — though the player might or might not have recognised the sigil before. She deals in illicit goods (weapons, “exotic” items, smokepowder and the like) and buys prisoners from goblin bands; above all she sells discretion and profit. She’s been doing business in or near a goblin camp, but some of her usual sources have started sending captives to Moonrise Towers, so she’s been adapting (and still made a tidy sum selling smokepowder). Her manner is blunt, breezy and impatient: everything’s business, she has no patience for moralising, and she expects you to either trade or be on your way.
- LOW_OskarsBeloved_OskarAlternativeState.json: Oskar is in the Guildhall, working as a counterfeiter with the Zhentarim. If the player met him previously and refused/failed to help him, he's quite angry at them, but has nonetheless managed to create a more comfortable situation for himself. If the player never met him, he's simply a counterfeiter trying to sell them a fake painting he needs to offload.
- PLA_ZhentDungeon_Zhent03_AD_Zhent04.json: Brem and Garias are brothers, ADing back and forth about the artist they've taken captive (or sold)

Roah Moonglow is a Zhentarim trader — you can spot the winged‑serpent crest — though the player might or might not have recognised the sigil before. She’s been doing business in or near a goblin camp, but some of her usual sources have started sending captives to Moonrise Towers, so she’s been adapting (and still made a tidy sum selling smokepowder). context: Brem is a Zhentarim trader/handler who’s presenting a captive artist (likely Oskar Fevras) as merchandise, calling him a “pet” and insisting the Zhentarim provide his “protection” while actually holding him against his will. He offers to paint portraits for coin and explicitly invites offers to buy or ransom the prisoner, treating the interaction as a blunt, profit‑minded business negotiation. The player can purchase the artist, persuade Brem to free him instead, or simply haggle for other trade — Brem will bristle at moralising and press for payment or valuable goods. He also hints that more illicit items will be shown once the party proves themselves to his superiors (other Zhentarim quartermasters or gatekeepers may be nearby).
